newsitem.title: UK: FTSE 100 opens weaker, tracking Dow, focus on stg.
newsitem.headline: FTSE 100 opens weaker, tracking Dow, focus on stg.

text.p: The FTSE 100 opened slightly weaker on Thursday in line with the Dow's 21-point overnight loss before recovering to be up 0.9 points at 4,388.6 by 0800 GMT.
FTSE futures squeezed up and took the cash market off bottom levels with the June contract showing a two-point gain to 4,410.
"The market's really kicking its heels until the election while keeping an eye on Wall Street," said BZW's head of European strategy, Richard Kersley.
